name: Лежит — ноги подогнуты
description: Расслабленная поза лёжа с согнутыми ногами на подходящей горизонтальной поверхности.

layouts.name: Частично на боку
required: lying comfortably on a horizontal surface
body resting partly on the side

torso.text: torso angled slightly toward the viewer
upper body supported by one forearm

legs.text: knees bent gently to one side
one leg bent more than the other

hands.text: one arm resting near the head
one hand resting lightly on the body
both arms resting naturally on the surface

head.text: face turned slightly toward the viewer

layouts.name: На спине с поворотом корпуса
required: lying on the back on a horizontal surface
torso turned slightly toward one side

legs.text: one knee raised higher than the other
both knees leaning gently to one side

hands.text: one arm resting beside the head
one hand resting near the waist

layouts.name: Верхняя часть тела приподнята
required: legs bent in a relaxed asymmetrical position

support.text: upper body supported by both arms behind the body
upper body supported by one elbow

layouts.name: Ракурс между согнутыми ногами
required: lying on the back on a horizontal surface
both legs bent and positioned on opposite sides of the frame
strong perspective foreshortening from a low frontal viewpoint

legs.text: one knee positioned noticeably closer to the camera than the other
both knees raised with mild asymmetry
one leg raised higher while the other remains bent lower

torso.text: upper body resting flat on the supporting surface
upper torso turned slightly to one side
shoulders raised slightly from the supporting surface

hands.text: arms resting naturally beside the torso
one hand resting on the supporting surface near the hip
one arm bent loosely beside the upper body

head.text: face angled generally toward the camera
head turned slightly to one side
chin lowered slightly toward the torso

camera.text: extreme low frontal view from between the bent legs
